evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC output and help text in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Resolves an RPC inconsistency where `getchainstates` reported verification progress against the active network tip instead of the snapshot base block, conflicting with `getblockchaininfo` during assumeutxo sync. While this corrects returned data for background sync monitoring, it is a minor reporting defect that can be reasonably deferred.
